core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fitri is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Natural, innate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fitri corresponds to the Arabic form فِطْرِي (Arabic root ف ط ر (f-ṭ-r); فِطْرِيّ (Fiṭrī)). Its core sense is fitri; natural, innate (indonesian form). Fitri is the Indonesian form of Arabic فِطْرِيّ (Fiṭrī), meaning 'natural, innate'. It is used as a female given name.
